                    result.append('ü')
                    i += 2
                    continue

            if s[i] == 's' and s[i+1] == 's':
                if naive or len(s) > 2:
                    result.append('ß')
                    i += 2
                    continue
        result.append(s[i])
        i += 1
    return ''.join(result)
